verdict.rationale: NotebookLM lets researchers upload PDFs (up to 500k words/200MB) plus other formats, then chat/query grounded strictly in those sources with inline citations, source selection, and note-taking for synthesis—directly matching the 'upload corpus and research over it' story. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for structured research workflows, though one comment notes it can't proactively search/add external docs itself. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of research quality/accuracy at scale and broader corpus ingestion (e.g., email) without workarounds.
